heading_path: Part 48 Removal of a Trade Mark from the Register for Non-use
Part 48.11. Where there is no evidence in support of the opposition

provisions.mention: Regulations 9.17 and 17A.48S of the Trade Mark Regulations 1995
Regulations 9.17 and 17A.48S of the Trade Mark Regulations 1995

chunks.text: Trade Marks Act 1995 Trade Marks Regulations 1995 Regulations 9.17 and 17A.48S of the Trade Mark Regulations 1995 set out the process to be followed where an opponent to a non-use application has neither filed evidence in support nor requested a hearing. The process for an opposed non-use application where the opponent has neither filed evidence in support nor requested a hearing is the same as the process when the non-use application is not opposed.
